$schema_note: Prompts de génération d'images pour les assets flagship de PROOF (DA V2.0 « Clinical warmth »). Model-agnostique : compatibles Midjourney v6+, Flux, DALL·E 3, SDXL/Ideogram. Chaque asset porte le nom de fichier exact attendu par lib/product-image.ts — dépose le rendu dans public/products/ sous ce nom et il s'affiche automatiquement.
brand: PROOF — premium medical-grade silicone scar patches

art_direction.concept: Clinical warmth — quiet luxury skincare. La peau est le sujet, le site est lumineux. Références : Dr. Barbara Sturm (autorité clinique lumineuse), Aesop (warm minimalism), La Mer (luxe cinématique), Rhode (modernité soft, peau réelle).

palette.kintsugi_gold: #C9A227 matte gold, only as a repaired seam, never as a flat fill

art_direction.lighting: Soft natural directional daylight from upper-left, single gentle shadow. For product and texture: low raking light at ~20 degrees to reveal silicone surface. No hard flash, no ring-light catchlights.
art_direction.surfaces: Warm off-white plaster, limestone, unpolished travertine, raw ceramic, linen — always light and warm, never black seamless.
art_direction.product_facts: The patch is a translucent nude/beige medical-grade silicone rectangle, 5x15 cm, softly rounded corners, faint embossed repeating 'P' monogram texture, slightly satin finish. The gel is a matte charcoal airless pump bottle with a brushed-steel collar and thin 'PROOF' wordmark, 30 ml.
art_direction.casting: Real, diverse people, natural unretouched skin, a visible scar shown openly and honored — never airbrushed away, never a wound. Calm, self-possessed, editorial.
art_direction.format_default: 4:5 vertical, high resolution >= 2000px on long edge, photorealistic editorial beauty photography, medium-format look, shot on 80-120mm, shallow but controlled depth of field.

global_negative_prompt: pure black background, dark studio, moody low-key, hypebeast, streetwear, neon, gradients as decoration, glassmorphism, colored shadows, HDR, oversaturation, plastic skin, heavy retouching, airbrushed scar, before-and-after split, medical clinical coldness, pharmacy stock photo, watermark, logo text overlay, UI, caption, lens flare, fisheye, deformed hands, extra fingers, blurry, low-res, cartoon, 3d render look, AI artifacts

assets.placement: Home hero, bleed right, vertical portrait behind the headline 'Your scar has a story.'
assets.prompt: Editorial beauty portrait of a self-possessed woman in her early 30s with natural bare skin and a real, healed thin scar visible along her cheekbone, worn openly and calmly, soft direct gaze just off camera. Warm off-white plaster background (#F5F1EA), soft natural window light from the upper left grazing the skin, single gentle shadow. Minimal styling, no makeup gloss, dewy realistic skin texture with visible pores. Quiet-luxury skincare campaign in the spirit of La Mer and Dr. Barbara Sturm. Photorealistic medium-format photography, 100mm, controlled shallow depth of field, warm neutral color grade, generous negative space on the right for text.
assets.negative_prompt: black background, dark mood, heavy makeup, airbrushed or hidden scar, wound, blood, sadness, clinical coldness, stock-photo smile, gradient backdrop

usage_notes.midjourney: Ajoute --ar depuis 'aspect_ratio' et --style raw --v 6 ; colle 'prompt', puis '--no ' suivi de 'negative_prompt'.
usage_notes.flux_sdxl: Utilise 'prompt' et 'negative_prompt' tels quels ; guidance 3-4 (Flux) ou CFG 5-7 (SDXL) pour garder le naturel de la peau.
usage_notes.dalle3: Colle 'prompt' et ajoute en fin de phrase les interdits clés du negative ('no black background, no before-and-after, no gradients').
usage_notes.dropin: Enregistre chaque rendu sous 'filename' dans public/products/ (jpg/webp/avif/png acceptés) ; le slot s'affiche automatiquement, ratio 4:5 conseillé pour cartes et hero.
usage_notes.consistency: Génère hero + ritual-clean/apply/wear avec la même personne et la même lumière (seed/cref fixes) ; garde les packshots sur le même fond limestone/porcelaine.
